name: Fabryka Farb i Lakierów Sniezka SA
summary: Fabryka Farb i Lakierów Sniezka SA engages in the manufacture and sale decorative paints and construction chemicals in Poland, Hungary, Ukraine, Belarus, and internationally. The company offers paints for internal walls and facades, products for painting wood and metal, putties for walls and wood, and thermal insulation systems for buildings under the Sniezka, Magnat, Vidaron, Rafil and Foveo-Tech brands. It also provides varnishes, solvents, and adhesives. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.
